instruction: Fix `common_prefix` so it returns the full common prefix without dropping the last matching character (off-by-one in the return slice).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/textutils.py b/textutils.py
--- a/textutils.py
+++ b/textutils.py
@@ -50,7 +50,7 @@
     i = 0
     while i < len(a) and i < len(b) and a[i] == b[i]:
         i += 1
-    return a[:i - 1]
+    return a[:i]
